answer: Each identity's usable standing is released only after a sequential, non-transferable custody period, and the release rate is super-linear in how many identities an operator runs, so a fleet cannot mature faster than one identity at a time. The cost of one more head is paid in full and is never amortised across the fleet. The marble is the serial tenure, the plume the custody window that must elapse, and the lotus the standing released at the end of it; the marble is personal, the plume is not skippable, and the lotus cannot be inherited by a sibling.
